```sql
SELECT ad_spend.marketing_channel AS answer
FROM staging.stg_marketing__ad_spend AS ad_spend
JOIN reference.marketing_channels AS mc
  ON ad_spend.marketing_channel = mc.marketing_channel
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates AS fx
  ON ad_spend.spend_date = fx.rate_date
WHERE ad_spend.spend_date >= '2025-04-01'
  AND ad_spend.spend_date <= '2026-03-31'
  AND mc.is_paid = TRUE
GROUP BY ad_spend.marketing_channel
ORDER BY SUM(
  CASE 
    WHEN ad_spend.currency = 'AUD' THEN ad_spend.spend_local * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
    ELSE ad_spend.spend_local 
  END
) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
